⚖️

RBI 2025 Tiered LTV Framework

≤2.5L85% Cap

Small-ticket loans retain the highest borrowing headroom.

2.5–5L80% Cap

Mid-ticket loans - where stacking risk is now concentrated.

>5L75% Cap

Large-ticket loans face the tightest margin requirement.

⚠️
Checked Across Every Lender, Not Just One Loan
RBI now requires lenders to add up a borrower's gold loans across ALL lenders before setting the loan-to-value limit - checking just the one loan in front of you is no longer enough.
Overall Risk Read
LowModerateElevatedSevere

Leverage, unsecured exposure and loan-stacking are all climbing together - the tiered LTV cap is the market's primary brake right now.

Why Now

The compliance deadline already passed. The market didn't wait.

On June 6, 2025 the RBI replaced 30+ years of scattered gold-loan circulars with one binding Master Direction. The hard compliance deadline has come and gone — and the organised market hit its FY26 target a full year early.
